purpose: Prospective context-only evaluation of Kronos directional agreement on primary flow-cluster candidates.
decision_rule: Kronos remains context-only. Do not gate entries or alter sizing before the minimum scored sample is reached and a locked analysis shows stable benefit.
notes: The zero prediction threshold is direction-only and was chosen to avoid adopting the exploratory 0.025 percent threshold from the historical review.
Every distance-eligible candidate must be scored regardless of Kronos agreement.
The first stored prediction for a candidate/configuration is immutable.
